title: Billie Holiday, marijuana and why he stuck to whiskey
summary: He walked with Billie Holiday between shows and says he avoided drugs, which Kansas City also had.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x:
"Come on a California, Joe, I'll see that you get in the movies."
So, I run into Billie Holiday. Me and Billie Holiday got to be friends, so I used to walk with her up and down the street in between shows, while she would go out on the sidewalk, walkin' up and down the street...smoke pot. Well, I didn' know nothin'...me, I didn't know nothin' about no pot. I was dumb to the fact.
They didn't have that in Kansas City, huh?

They had it there. They had everything there.
I just never tried it. I didn't go...go in for nothin' like that. Me, I drank whiskey. That's mah...mah stick. I didn't went no further than that in all my life. Rest of that stuff, I didn't go in for it. They had cocaine...people shootin' needles...everythin' in Kansas City. But I didn't feel that...bother 'round about fool with nothin' like that. But I was always ascarred...scared that if you get on that stuff, you can't get off.

And I seed a lot of people that were foolin' with that stuff, I seen how they act, you know. I say, "Ah, that ain't for me." Stand around half 'sleep some place, don't know what's goin' on. Not me. I can't dig that.
